esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; U2.COIN → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ resistor from COIN to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added a separate 12 V supply for DC+12 (it needs 10.8–13.2 V and up to 800 mA, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the ch926.py driver written from the datasheet.
Counts a 3-pulse coin (50 ms MEDIUM pulses) as 3 credits: passes
